description: `emergencyTransfer(recipient)` is `onlyOwner` and sweeps the full phUSD AND rewardToken balances of the contract to an owner-chosen address, then pauses. There is no timelock, no multisig requirement on-chain, no event prior to the sweep, and NO accounting cleanup: `totalStaked`, `rewardBalance`, `accPhUSDPerShare`, `accStablePerShare`, and `userInfo[*]` are left intact. After execution the contract is an inconsistent shell — `userInfo[u].amount > 0` but `phUSD.balanceOf(this) == 0`, so `pauseWithdraw` reverts at SafeERC20 (no balance) and stakers lose principal absent off-chain remediation. Matches CENTRALIZATION-ADMIN signature (`onlyOwner` on critical funds path). Per the pattern's note, C4 typically treats centralization as Low/QA — BUT this specific path enables a single-tx rug, which the pattern explicitly carves out as the case to escalate.
vulnerableConditionsMet: Single EOA can drain all contract funds in one tx
No accounting cleanup => `pauseWithdraw` fallback is bricked
missingMitigations: Reset userInfo/totalStaked/rewardBalance on sweep so accounting stays consistent
Cap on sweepable assets (e.g., only rewardToken, not stake)
